source_metadata.exact_title: 2024 ACC Expert Consensus Decision Pathway for Treatment of Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction
source_metadata.authors: Maddox TM, Januzzi JL Jr, Allen LA, Breathett K, Brouse S, Butler J, Davis LL, Fonarow GC, Ibrahim NE, Lindenfeld J, Masoudi FA, Motiwala SR, Oliveros E, Walsh MN, Wasserman A, Yancy CW, Youmans QR
source_metadata.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
source_metadata.source_type: Expert Consensus Decision Pathway, secondary clinical policy and implementation guidance

atoms.canonical_statement: The 2024 pathway updates the 2021 ACC HFrEF expert consensus decision pathway with newer evidence and provides practical guidance for managing patients with HFrEF.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway focuses primarily on ambulatory patients with chronic HFrEF, defined as clinical heart failure with LVEF 40% or less, who do not have symptoms or signs of clinical instability.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For a patient with orthopnea or uncomfortable peripheral edema, the pathway advises initial diuretic therapy with early follow-up toward decongestion before applying the chronic HFrEF pathway.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The writing committee endorses the evidence-based approaches to heart failure therapy and management in the 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA heart failure guideline.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway assumes clinicians will seek input from pharmacists, cardiologists, heart failure specialists, disease-management programs, or other relevant specialists when needed.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Patient preferences and values, together with evidence-based clinical judgment, should guide clinical decision-making throughout HFrEF care.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway states that new data may supersede its suggestions and algorithms at any time.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway defines optimal therapy as guideline-directed medical therapy given at the target dose or the highest tolerated dose for the individual patient.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway defines target doses as the doses targeted in clinical trials.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For the 2024 update, ACC convened structured discussions about new therapies, unanswered questions, adherence, and implementation strategies, including multidisciplinary panel discussions.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The writing committee met by conference call, and when formal consensus was required, it used roll-call or email voting with a simple majority; the chair cast the deciding vote when a majority could not be achieved.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway underwent formal peer review, including a public comment period, and the revised document was approved by the ACC Clinical Policy Approval Committee.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: ACC conflict-of-interest policy required the ECDP chair or co-chair to have no relevant relationship with industry and required members with relevant relationships to remain below 50% of the writing group.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The supplemental preface states that expert consensus decision pathways do not provide a single correct answer to clinical questions and instead ask clinicians to weigh relevant factors for individual treatment plans.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway notes that many of its pivotal implementation issues have not been the subject of clinical trials.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Once a patient with HFrEF is approaching or has achieved euvolemia, therapies proven to reduce morbidity and mortality should be added and optimized rather than relying on loop diuretics alone.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The core four-drug regimen for HFrEF consists of an ARNI, an evidence-based beta-blocker, a mineralocorticoid antagonist, and an SGLT inhibitor.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway reports no single optimal order for starting or titrating the four core HFrEF medication classes and recommends individualized sequencing.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Regardless of sequence, the pathway recommends early and rapid initiation and titration with the goal of using all four core medication classes in each eligible patient.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For de novo HFrEF, the pathway recommends reaching target or maximally tolerated doses of the four core classes as soon as possible and ideally within three months.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For patients already receiving part of the core HFrEF regimen, missing therapies should be started and titrated on a timeline shorter than the three-month goal used for de novo HFrEF.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Some patients may start all four core HFrEF medication classes simultaneously at low doses, and more than one therapy may be titrated at the same time.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway prefers direct initiation of sacubitril/valsartan when feasible rather than requiring prior ACE inhibitor or ARB exposure.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: ARNI initiation is often better tolerated while a patient remains congested, whereas beta-blocker initiation is generally better tolerated after decongestion with an adequate resting heart rate.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: A beta-blocker should not be newly started during decompensated heart failure, although an existing beta-blocker can be continued during decompensation when clinically appropriate.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Only carvedilol, metoprolol succinate, or bisoprolol are identified as evidence-based beta-blockers for HFrEF in the pathway.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Mineralocorticoid antagonists, SGLT inhibitors, and vericiguat have minimal or no blood-pressure-lowering effect at the doses discussed in the pathway.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Sacubitril/valsartan is the preferred renin-angiotensin system inhibitor for symptomatic chronic HFrEF when it can be used safely and accessed.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment with a mineralocorticoid antagonist is not required before starting or switching to an ARNI and should not delay ARNI use.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: When switching from an ACE inhibitor to an ARNI, a 36-hour washout should be observed to reduce angioedema risk; no corresponding washout is required when switching from an ARB.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Hospitalization for HFrEF is an opportunity to start or optimize GDMT after hemodynamic stabilization, with continued titration during the hospital-to-home transition.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For patients with low systolic blood pressure, ARNI initiation requires careful dosing and follow-up, and reducing loop diuretic dose may mitigate hypotension in patients who are stable and not congested.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway describes a limited role for ARNI in advanced HFrEF with NYHA class IV symptoms but recommends use in patients who can tolerate it, with close monitoring for adverse effects such as hyperkalemia.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For ACE inhibitor or ARB naive patients who otherwise meet criteria for ARNI therapy, the pathway prefers de novo ARNI initiation with close monitoring of blood pressure, electrolytes, kidney function, angioedema risk, and hypotension.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: If ARNI cannot be used because of contraindication, intolerance, access, or cost, an ACE inhibitor or ARB should be used to reduce morbidity and mortality in HFrEF.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: SGLT inhibitors are a core HFrEF therapy regardless of whether the patient has diabetes.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: SGLT inhibitor initiation can increase diuresis, so loop diuretic dose may need adjustment to avoid volume depletion.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway states that reduced kidney function does not eliminate the cardiovascular benefit of SGLT inhibitors in HFrEF and that an expected early fall in eGFR alone should not prompt automatic discontinuation.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: SGLT inhibitor therapy can reduce hyperkalemia risk and may help patients remain on mineralocorticoid antagonist therapy.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Ivabradine is an adjunct for chronic HFrEF with LVEF 35% or less, sinus rhythm, resting heart rate at least 70 beats per minute, NYHA class II or III symptoms, and maximally tolerated beta-blocker therapy.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Ivabradine should be titrated, when possible, to a resting heart rate of 50 to 60 beats per minute.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Ivabradine is not intended for persistent or chronic atrial fibrillation, complete atrial pacing, or unstable heart failure; a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is not by itself a contraindication.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Vericiguat may be considered for selected high-risk patients with HFrEF who have recent worsening heart failure despite maximally tolerated GDMT.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: After HFrEF diagnosis, ARNI, an evidence-based beta-blocker, a mineralocorticoid antagonist, and an SGLT inhibitor should be initiated and adjusted frequently with the aim of rapidly reaching target doses.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Clinical status, blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes should be assessed frequently during rapid HFrEF medication optimization.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Ventricular function should generally be reassessed three to six months after target or maximally tolerated GDMT is achieved to guide decisions about ICD or CRT therapy.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For severe functional mitral regurgitation, the pathway recommends optimizing GDMT and using team-based decision-making before referral for transcatheter edge-to-edge mitral repair.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: A patient may reasonably decline a newer HFrEF therapy after informed discussion of benefits and risks, and the pathway also calls for shared decision-making when life expectancy is shorter than one year because of advanced HF or other comorbidities.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: HFrEF therapies should be titrated rapidly to maximally tolerated doses, but doses above those studied in randomized trials are not known to add benefit and are generally not recommended.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: More than one HFrEF drug may be started or titrated at the same time, and in selected circumstances all four core classes may be started together.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: In a patient without decompensated HF or a contraindication to higher doses, beta-blocker doses can be adjusted every one to two weeks, with slower titration for frailty or marginal hemodynamics.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: ARNI dose can be increased as often as weekly in clinically stable patients while monitoring blood pressure, kidney function, and potassium.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: A mineralocorticoid antagonist does not require target or maximally tolerated doses of the other HFrEF drugs before it is added.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: An SGLT inhibitor does not require target or maximally tolerated doses of other GDMT before addition and is used at a fixed dose without titration.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For self-identified African-American patients with persistent NYHA class III or IV symptoms after the four core HFrEF classes are optimized, hydralazine plus isosorbide dinitrate should be added with attention to blood pressure and adverse effects.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: If resting heart rate remains at least 70 beats per minute in sinus rhythm on target or maximally tolerated beta-blocker therapy, ivabradine can be added and titrated.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: In selected high-risk patients with worsening HFrEF, vericiguat can be added and titrated every two weeks to its target dose.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The committee states that, although direct trial data are lacking, lower doses across multiple GDMT classes are likely more effective than high doses of only one or two classes.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For hyperkalemia that limits GDMT, the pathway recommends low-potassium diet education first, prioritization of an SGLT inhibitor, and consideration of newer potassium binders when needed.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Kidney function and potassium should be checked within one to two weeks after starting or increasing an ARNI, ACE inhibitor, or ARB.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: After mineralocorticoid antagonist initiation or titration, kidney function and potassium should be checked within one to two weeks, then at least monthly for the first three months and every three months thereafter when clinically stable.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: A fall in eGFR greater than 30% or development of hyperkalemia during treatment that affects kidney function should prompt reassessment and may require dose reduction, while short transient eGFR changes during diuresis or renin-angiotensin-aldosterone inhibition do not automatically require dose reduction.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Virtual care and home visiting nurse services can support GDMT optimization when travel, homebound status, or other access barriers prevent frequent in-person assessment.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: After initial titration, most patients with chronic HFrEF should be evaluated about every three to six months, with more frequent follow-up when clinical stability or further GDMT titration requires it.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: An echocardiogram is recommended when heart failure is first diagnosed to assess ventricular function, chamber structure, valves, and hemodynamic features.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Repeat cardiac imaging after three to six months of optimal GDMT can guide device therapy, transcatheter mitral repair, or referral for advanced therapies, with timing individualized by risk and expected remodeling.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Routine annual surveillance echocardiography is not warranted when there is no change in clinical status or other signal of risk.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: When LVEF improves above 40% after prior HFrEF, GDMT should still be continued and titrated unless a defined reversible cause supports a different approach.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: BNP or NT-proBNP measurement is useful for diagnosis, disease severity, prognosis, and longitudinal risk assessment in HFrEF.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Because neprilysin inhibition can modestly raise BNP, NT-proBNP may be easier to interpret than BNP in patients receiving sacubitril/valsartan.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Routine pulmonary artery catheterization is not recommended for congestion management, but invasive hemodynamic assessment can be useful for refractory symptoms, worsening kidney function during diuresis, recurrent congestion admissions, or advanced-therapy evaluation.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Implantable pulmonary artery pressure monitoring may guide treatment in carefully selected ambulatory patients with recurrent congestion and requires an organized team that can act on the data.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: New-onset heart failure should prompt specialist referral when help is needed to establish etiology, complete guideline-directed evaluation, or consider advanced imaging, biopsy, or genetic testing.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Chronic heart failure with high-risk features such as persistent NYHA III or IV symptoms, hypotension, kidney dysfunction, arrhythmias, repeated HF visits or hospitalizations, GDMT intolerance, or progressive clinical deterioration should prompt heart failure specialist referral.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Persistently reduced LVEF of 35% or less despite at least three months of GDMT should prompt referral for ICD or CRT consideration when device therapy is consistent with the patient’s goals and not contraindicated.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Patients with established advanced heart failure should have at least annual review of current and possible therapies, disease trajectory, prognosis, preferences, and advance care planning.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: HFrEF care should be patient-centered, use shared decision-making, and maintain communication across the disciplines involved in the patient’s care.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway recommends team-based heart failure care because randomized trials have shown better mortality, hospitalization, length-of-stay, and quality-of-life outcomes than usual care.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: A heart failure team should be able to diagnose and monitor HF, prescribe and titrate treatment, educate patients and caregivers, support lifestyle changes, coordinate comorbid care, and provide psychological, social, nutritional, palliative, and end-of-life support.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Referral to heart failure medication optimization clinics that focus on rapid initiation and titration of quadruple GDMT can reduce therapeutic inertia.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Electronic health records can support communication, medication reconciliation, and identification of patients receiving inadequate GDMT.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Remote monitoring technologies should only be useful when the care team has a clear process to receive, interpret, and act on the information; the pathway notes that many newer tools still need more evidence for broad use.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Medication adherence in HFrEF is a spectrum rather than a yes-or-no state, and the pathway cites significant nonadherence estimates of roughly 20% to 50%.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Because patients with heart failure often take many drugs for HF and comorbidities, adherence interventions should be multidisciplinary, multifactorial, and tailored to the individual patient.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Clinicians should assess adherence regularly because clinicians tend to overestimate actual adherence and no single measure of adherence is perfect.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway favors a shared, supportive approach to adherence rather than blame-based language or a compliance model.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway identifies patient education, medication-regimen management, pharmacist comanagement, cognitive behavioral interventions, reminders, and incentives as categories of adherence interventions.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway summarizes evidence that face-to-face pharmacist-delivered, habit-focused adherence interventions have been among the most effective medication-adherence strategies studied.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Practical adherence strategies include simplifying regimens, discussing cost, using 90-day supplies when appropriate, synchronizing refills, providing clear medication-purpose education, using teach-back, and monitoring refill gaps.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Health systems can support adherence by integrating pharmacists, patient navigators, and registered nurses into collaborative care and by using coverage and cost-sharing policies that reduce access barriers.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: African-American patients with HFrEF should receive the same four core HFrEF medication classes as other patients when indicated: ARNI or an ACE inhibitor or ARB, an evidence-based beta-blocker, an SGLT inhibitor, and a mineralocorticoid antagonist.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For an African-American patient who remains symptomatic after core GDMT, hydralazine plus isosorbide dinitrate should be considered and titrated with close blood-pressure and adverse-effect monitoring.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: ARNI should be avoided in any patient with a history of angioedema.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: If an African-American patient remains tachycardic in sinus rhythm, ivabradine may be considered, but beta-blocker optimization is preferred because trial data in African-American patients are sparse.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Social barriers to GDMT and optimal HFrEF management should be assessed and addressed to reduce inequities in heart failure outcomes.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: In older adults, clinicians should attempt guideline-directed target doses while closely monitoring adverse drug reactions and considering the patient’s overall medication burden and comorbidities.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway notes that optimal GDMT doses in older adults may be lower than doses studied in trials or tolerated by younger patients, and deprescribing may be appropriate when it prevents or corrects medication-related harm.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway reports no evidence that HFrEF therapies should be withheld or automatically dose-reduced solely because a patient meets frailty criteria.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: For patients living with frailty, multidomain rehabilitation with cognitive and nutritional support can accompany standard HFrEF GDMT.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Access and affordability of every component of GDMT should be reassessed periodically to support treatment persistence.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Cost-reduction strategies include avoiding duplicate testing, considering insurance coverage, using generic equivalents when possible, and working with pharmacists, social workers, or patient navigators to find assistance programs.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Prior-authorization and patient-assistance needs should be assessed at the time a medication is prescribed rather than after a delay in therapy occurs.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The pathway advises waiting until a patient has demonstrated tolerability and has been titrated to the intended GDMT dose before applying to manufacturer-based patient assistance programs that supply a fixed prescription.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: The supplemental appendix provides product-specific medication coverage resources for sacubitril/valsartan, SGLT inhibitors, ivabradine, and hydralazine/isosorbide dinitrate.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Prior-authorization documentation should identify the HF phenotype and NYHA class, document recent LVEF when requested, explain the requested therapy or test and prior therapies, address contraindications and risk mitigation, and document when delay or interruption may harm the patient.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Clinicians should discuss and document social determinants of health at each encounter because social circumstances can change over time and alter risk and access to care.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Care teams should build and use resources that address identified social needs, including medication-cost support, access to nutritious food, and heart-failure education.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: GDMT is the foundation of HFrEF care, and therapies with the greatest expected benefit should be prioritized.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Target doses are associated with the best outcomes, so titration should continue when tolerated even if the patient appears stable or symptoms and LVEF improve.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: GDMT should be started promptly and titrated at each encounter, with the goal of completing initiation and titration within two to three months or sooner.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Clinical, social, and financial barriers to GDMT should be identified repeatedly and addressed with multidisciplinary care tailored to the patient.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Diligent management of volume status is central to symptom control, and uncertain volume status may justify right-heart catheterization or heart failure specialist referral.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline

atoms.canonical_statement: Before reducing evidence-based therapy for symptomatic hypotension, clinicians should look for overdiuresis, noncardiovascular drugs with hemodynamic effects, autonomic dysfunction, or simultaneous dosing effects and address reversible causes.

provenance.extractor_identifier: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol / ATOM SEA Literature Pipeline
